Check out this pre-owned 2015 MINI Cooper Countryman we recently got in.

This SUV is a great example of beauty and brawn with classic styling and a workhorse power plant. You could spend more on fuel each month than on your vehicle payments, so why not consider one with exceptional fuel economy like this 2015 MINI Cooper Countryman.

Enjoy driving? Well now you will get more thrills behind the wheel thanks to the heightened performance of AWD. Better handling. Better traction. Better driving experience. With less than 87,576mi on this MINI Cooper Countryman, you'll appreciate the practically showroom newness of this vehicle.

More information about the 2015 MINI Cooper Countryman:

The Countryman incorporates the peppy and perky driving experience--and easy parking and maneuverability--of the MINI Cooper lineup, yet with a more spacious interior and a wider range of capabilities that might be of use to those who head to the outdoors on the weekends. Fuel economy is quite good for base models, at 27 mpg city, 35 highway. But the stronger, quicker Countryman S and JCW models are the way to go for most shoppers who want to make the most of this car's excellent steering and suspension tuning--which makes a little bit of sacrifice in ride in the name of crisp handling.

This model sets itself apart with available all-wheel drive, crisp handling, perky turbocharged S and high performance JCW models, Stylish look inside and out, and easy parking and maneuverability

The 2020 Ford Escape SE in Oxford White is a compact SUV that offers a comfortable, versatile, and practical driving experience. With a clean and timeless Oxford White exterior, this Escape presents itself as a vehicle thats both stylish and functional perfect for everyday commuting, weekend adventures, and everything in between. The SE trim strikes a strong balance between comfort, technology, and value, making this SUV a popular choice for drivers who want a wellrounded vehicle thats easy to live with.

On the outside, the Oxford White paint gives the Escape a fresh and refined appearance. The bright, neutral tone highlights the vehicles smooth body lines and wellproportioned shape, creating a look thats modern without being overly flashy. The Escapes design features a balanced, aerodynamic profile with subtle curves and sculpted edges that enhance its visual appeal. From its bold front grille and sleek headlights to its sturdy wheel arches and clean rear end, the overall exterior aesthetic feels cohesive and thoughtfully designed. Whether parked or on the move, this Escape draws attention for its crisp, polished look.

Stepping inside the 2020 Escape SE, youll find a cabin designed with comfort, convenience, and practicality in mind. The interior offers a welcoming atmosphere with comfortable seating for up to five passengers. The seats provide good support for both short trips and longer journeys, and theres ample headroom and legroom in both the front and rear seats. The materials throughout the cabin feel solid and wellassembled, giving the interior a quality feel that holds up well to daily use. Thoughtful storage solutions, such as door pockets, cupholders, and a roomy center console, help keep essentials organized and within easy reach.

Technology and connectivity are important parts of the Escape SEs appeal. The dashboard features a userfriendly layout with an infotainment touchscreen that puts essential controls and information right at your fingertips. The system supports smartphone integration, so you can easily connect your phone for handsfree calling, navigation, music streaming, and compatible apps helping you stay connected and entertained on the go. Additional USB ports and convenient charging options help keep everyones devices powered up during drives.

Under the hood, the 2020 Escape SE delivers a smooth and responsive driving experience. Its engine provides a good balance of power and efficiency, making it capable of confident acceleration on city streets and comfortable cruising on highways. The Escapes suspension is tuned to provide a comfortable ride over a variety of road surfaces, absorbing bumps and road imperfections without feeling overly stiff. Steering feels light and predictable, making it easy to maneuver in traffic and around tight corners. Whether youre navigating daily errands or setting out on a longer road trip, the Escape feels composed and easy to handle.

Cargo space is another strength of the Escape. The rear cargo area offers generous room for luggage, groceries, sports gear, and more, and the rear seats fold down easily to expand the storage area when needed. This flexibility makes packing larger items or handling bigger hauls simple and stressfree. The wide rear hatch opening also helps make loading and unloading everyday items effortless.

GR Auto Gallery is pleased to present this well-cared-for 1990 Buick Reatta Convertible for your consideration. Finished in stunning Arctic White over a rich Burgundy interior, this Reatta presents beautifully and shows just 79,212 miles on the odometer. Powering this Buick is the dependable 3.8 Liter V6 producing 165 horsepower, paired with an automatic transmission for smooth and effortless cruising. Only 2,132 convertibles were produced for the 1990 model year, making this a rare and desirable example. Features include an Alpine aftermarket stereo, Michelin Defender radial tires, manual convertible top, digital dash, flip-up headlights, power windows, tilt steering wheel, power seats, powered mirrors, powered locks, intermittent wipers, stow-away compartments, and a spacious trunk. This vehicle also features a brand new convertible top complete with a new headliner and rear glass, and numerous invoices of maintenance throughout ownership are included within the sale, highlighting the care this Reatta has received over the years. Drive this one out of our showroom or have us assist with shipping it to you anywhere in the United States! Don't hesitate to call us with any questions or for more information.



The 1991 Buick Reatta represented the final year of convertible production for the model and showcased Buick's commitment to blending luxury with innovative technology. Hand-assembled at the Reatta Craft Centre in Lansing, Michigan, the Reatta featured advanced elements for its time such as a digital instrument cluster and sleek, aerodynamic styling. Built on a shortened Riviera platform, the Reatta offered a unique combination of sporty character and refined comfort. With limited production numbers and distinctive late-80s/early-90s design cues, the Reatta has become a collectible modern classic appreciated for its individuality and craftsmanship.

Looking for a reliable and sporty coupe? This 2010 Ford Focus SE might be just what you need. With its sleek red exterior and comfortable gray interior, it's sure to turn heads. The 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine paired with a 5-speed manual transmission offers a fun driving experience. Features include:

ABS and AdvanceTrac for improved handling
SYNC system with Bluetooth connectivity
Sirius Satellite radio for endless entertainment
Convenient cruise control and power windows
Sporty rear spoiler and alloy wheels

At 153,000 miles, this Focus is in good condition and priced below average. Perfect for daily commutes or weekend adventures.

The car still runs great and have never had an issue with it from a mechanical standpoint. The car does have a tire pressure sensor alert that for whatever reason won't go away despite being fixed in the past and the tires not having low pressure. Car does have a 80mph limiter which has been on it since I got it which can be changed but might be great for a first car for your teenager!
